## Validation

- [ ] Existing behaviour was checked before the change.

- [ ] No duplicate observers, timers, listeners or panels were introduced.
- [ ] Saved settings remain compatible or migration is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated where required.
- [ ] Private information and debug output were removed.
